anchor.statement: Corollary 8.5. Under the hypotheses of Proposition 8.4, define the covariance targets H θ = −T 2 (︁⟨ E θ ⟩ Y − σ θ ε∂ Z J θ )︁ , H z = −T 1 (︁⟨ E z ⟩ Y − σ z ε∂ Z (J z + c ρ P))︁ (8.18) They are independent of the auxiliary variable, compactly supported in the active shell, and satisfy (D r + 2/R)H θ = −⟨E θ ⟩ Y + σ θ ε∂ Z J θ , (D r + 1/R)H z = −⟨E z ⟩ Y + σ z ε∂ Z (J z + c ρ P). The radial primitives act at fixed (Z, T). Thus H θ and H z vanish whenever their respective integrands in (8.18) vanish for every R; the construction does not enlarge support in the axial variable Z.

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: Split into the divergence identities (Dr + 2/R)σ = −(source − bump·moment) and (Dr + 1/R)σ = −(source − bump·moment) for the compact primitive σ of a smooth shell-supported mean source, and the bump identities that identify the removed moments with ε∂Z Jθ and ε∂Z(Jz + cρP); σ acts on mean fields at a fixed slow point, which gives the auxiliary independence and the Z-support clause.

  NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.momentDensity P 2 z.1 *

exact.text:
∀ (P : NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.Patch) (ε : ℝ)
  {v radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanField},
  NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell P.a P.b v →
    NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell P.a P.b radialFlux →
      NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell P.a P.b axialFlux →
        NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell P.a P.b virtualFlux →
          NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.radialMoment 2 v = 0 →
            ∀ (z : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanPoint),
              NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.bumpCorrection P 2
                  (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.angularBalance ε v radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux) z =
                NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.momentDensity P 2 z.1 *
                  (ε * (fderiv ℝ (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.radialMoment 2 axialFlux) z.2) (0, 1))

conclusion.text:
NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.bumpCorrection P 1
    (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.axialBalance ε γ radialFlux axialFlux
      (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.reconstructedMeanPressure d P.a P.b M ⋯ v f) virtualFlux)
    z =
  NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.momentDensity P 1 z.1 *
    (ε *
      (fderiv ℝ
          (NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.axialMomentPotential axialFlux
            (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.averagedRadialSource f)
            (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.normalizedMeanDensity P.a P.b ⋯))
          z.2)
        (0, 1))

      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
        NavierStokes.RadialAlias.RadiallySupported P.a P.b f →
          NavierStokes.PressureStream.TorusPeriodicLift f →
            ∀ {γ radialFlux axialFlux virtualFlux : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanField},
              NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.SmoothShell P.a P.b γ →

                      NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.radialMoment 1 γ = 0 →
                        ∀ (z : NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.MeanPoint),
                          NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.bumpCorrection P 1
                              (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.axialBalance ε γ radialFlux axialFlux
                                (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.reconstructedMeanPressure d P.a P.b M ⋯ v f)
                                virtualFlux)
                              z =
                            NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.momentDensity P 1 z.1 *
                              (ε *
                                (fderiv ℝ
                                    (NavierStokes.SignedStressPrimitive.axialMomentPotential axialFlux
                                      (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.averagedRadialSource f)
                                      (NavierStokes.IntegratedMeanBalances.normalizedMeanDensity P.a P.b ⋯))
                                    z.2)
                                  (0, 1))
